system.description: Your exhaled breath solidifies into a shimmering, holy mist around you or an ally within 10'. Sustained. You cannot speak while it holds.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the attacker takes d6 radiant damage.
outcomes.success: The mist blocks the next attack against the warded creature, then crumbles to ash.
outcomes.failure: The mist only softens the blow: the warded creature defends with Boon against the next attack, then the mist is gone.
outcomes.ruin: The breath catches in your throat: you are Silenced until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
